text.en:
Section 3 of Presidential Decree No. 306 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 3. The Veterans' Hospital shall be directly under the administrative supervision and control of the
Department of Health and as such shall not be subject to the supervision and/or control of any regional office
of said Department."

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th day of January in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
